paper_title: Defending Against Social Engineering Attacks in the Age of LLMs
caption: Inter-annotator agreement compared to sample-level ambiguity standard deviation and sample-level maximum ambiguity values.
model_annotation: This bar chart displays two separate visualizations comparing Fleiss Kappa values, a measure of inter-annotator agreement, against different metrics of ambiguity. The left chart plots Fleiss Kappa on the vertical axis, which ranges from 0.0 to 0.8 in increments of 0.2, against "Ambiguity Std" on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with the values 0.0, 0.47, 0.82, and 0.94. The bars are colored dark blue for the first bar (0.88), medium blue for the second (0.46), light blue for the third (0.03), and medium blue for the fourth (0.24). The right chart similarly plots Fleiss Kappa on the vertical axis (same scale) against "Max Ambiguity" on the horizontal axis, which is labeled with the integers 1, 2, and 3. The bars are colored dark blue for the first bar (0.89), medium blue for the second (0.46), and light blue for the third (0.23). In both charts, the bar height corresponds to the Fleiss Kappa value, which is also explicitly labeled on top of each bar. The bars are arranged in the order of the horizontal axis labels, with no visual emphasis or sorting beyond this order.
